effectiveFp.evidence: never measured. Technical FP is not effective FP: a finding counts against us when it is wrong, AND when it is right but nobody would act on it. Bar is 5% for anything a preset enables

reachability.evidence: the rule's default contract is not asserted. A rule enabled by default must report only when it can resolve a path from an untrusted source; "report unless proven safe" is a different product and belongs opt-in

knownGaps.summary: The canonical sink `fs.readFileSync(req.query.file)` is reported by this rule AND by node-security/no-arbitrary-file-access.
knownGaps.why: Open work, not a limit. Two rules in one plugin model the same sink, so a consumer enabling `recommended` sees the same defect twice with two different message shapes. Which rule owns direct fs-sink taint is a taxonomy decision.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: immediately — this is a defect, listed here so it is not lost

knownGaps.summary: The rule's marginal CPU cost does not clear the noise floor at two or more sizes, so no growth curve can be read.
knownGaps.why: Harness cost (parser + scope construction) is ~70ms at 8000 lines and dominates; the difference between two such measurements is larger than the rule's own contribution at 500 and 2000 lines. The same rule has measured +1.50ms and +0.00ms at 500 lines on consecutive runs. The property is decidable; the instrument is not sharp enough.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: a CPU profile attributing samples to the rule's own frames exists, or the sizes are raised until two points clear the floor

knownGaps.summary: The literal branch reports a hardcoded path that ARRIVES somewhere sensitive; whether a bare absolute path is CWE-22 at all is undecided.
knownGaps.why: Open work AND a contract question. `literal-paths.test.ts` deliberately asserts `fs.readFileSync('/etc/shadow')` reports. The single real-source instance — pm2/lib/tools/passwd.js:5, a file whose job is parsing /etc/passwd — reads as a false alarm under a traversal message. n=1 is not enough to overturn a deliberate decision, so the rule is unchanged.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: the literal branch's purpose is settled: traversal only, or sensitive destinations generally — and if the latter, whether it belongs under CWE-497 with its own message
